In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], an '''attack''' occurred on [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Emperor's Villa|villa]] by [[Whiplash]] fighters. The goal was to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Palpatine, but the attack had been expected, and while Whiplash managed to cause minor damage, the fighters were all killed.
